description: Troubleshoot an Alibaba Cloud ECS Linux OS. Use when a user needs to diagnose a specified ECS Linux instance, such as instance stuck in Starting, boot stuck, SSH/VNC/Workbench login failure, network issues, disk/FS issues, performance anomalies, suspected mining or hidden processes, crash/hang, clock drift, or configuration not taking effect.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
